text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The Federal Council has decided on a declaration obligation for commercial dishwashers", "gist": "Swiss Federal Council introduced a declaration requirement for commercial dishwashers"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "As of 1 January 2024", "gist": "The requirement starts on 1 January 2024"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "the energy and water consumption as well as the cleaning performance must be stated in the technical documentation and on a freely accessible website", "gist": "Commercial dishwashers must disclose energy/water use and cleaning performance in docs and on a public website"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "European standard EN IEC 63136:2019", "gist": "The European standard EN IEC 63136:2019 governs the disclosure format"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "There is no energy label for commercial dishwashers", "gist": "Commercial dishwashers do not have an energy label"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Switzerland is taking a pioneering role here, as there are currently no legal requirements for commercial dishwashers in the EU", "gist": "Switzerland is leading in this area because the EU has no legal requirements for commercial dishwashers"}]}
